description: Fetches NPR articles and section listings from www.npr.org with full content extraction.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: Fetch a single NPR article by URL; requires url; 参数: url; 必填: 无
  - get_section: List articles from an NPR section page; requires url or section; 参数: limit, url, section; 必填: 无

url.description: NPR article or section URL. Required for get_article. For get_section, can be used instead of section parameter. Example: https://www.npr.org/2020/12/08/944152693/article-slug

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return for get_section.

section.description: NPR section name for get_section (e.g., "science", "politics", "health"). Used to construct section URL if url not provided.
